summary.title: SST
summary.one_liner: SST is a framework for deploying an app's full stack (database, email, services, frontend) from a single config file.
takeaways: SST lets you declare a database, email sender, container service, and Next.js site in one TypeScript-style config.
Resources such as a database or email can be linked to a service or site so the app can use them.
Install the framework with npm i sst.
A Next.js frontend can be given a custom domain and DNS via Cloudflare in the same config.
summary.summary: The page is the landing page for SST, showing a sample config that defines a PlanetScale database, an AWS email sender, a containerized Rails API service with 4 GB memory, and a Next.js web app on a custom domain with Cloudflare DNS. It describes the tool as a way to deploy everything an app needs with a single config and gives the install command npm i sst. The text is mostly marketing with few details beyond the example, so no further features or pricing are stated here.
